method: Three-point affine registration of each main map; no administrative candidate edges used as controls. Enlarged southern insets and legends excluded.
controlLimitation: Three non-collinear controls determine six affine coefficients exactly, leaving no redundant control for an independent registration RMSE. Zero fit residual is not an accuracy estimate. Target corners come from the simplified modern PGMaps authority layer, not a cadastral survey.
limitations: This initial 18-area registration experiment omits council polygon scores; the extended estimates review adds all 34 council approximations separately. All southern insets and the twenty-region statistical map still require separate registrations.
All path-to-area assignments are preliminary and require independent review, especially islands and metropolitan detail.
Overlap measures registered publication artwork against simplified modern comparison polygons, not recovered historical legal GIS.
All source maps retain their 1997/98 publication context. Alignment does not establish an unchanged territory through 2001.
Only the three OAG administrative main maps are registered. The separate twenty-region Statistics Canada map and all enlarged insets are not registered.
15 km translation sensitivity omits rotation, scale, local distortion, source-generalization and path-assignment errors; high IoU can conceal important local differences.
classificationRule: Under 2,000 km²: detail-limited. Otherwise close if all 15 km translation scenarios have IoU >= 0.80; partial if nominal IoU >= 0.65; poor otherwise. These are exploratory display triage rules, not legal acceptance thresholds.
